verdict.rationale: Langfuse provides prompt version control, labels for deployment management, comparison of prompt/model/code changes, and CI/CD gating on regressions, which map to version/review/rollback of prompt-based automations rather than full pipeline rollback. There's no evidence of rolling back a full agent/workflow automation (only prompts), and no explicit UI 'rollback to previous version' action is documented beyond labels/version tracking. missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for entire agent workflows (not just prompts), evidence of rollback UI/action beyond version labels, independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback working in practice.
